summary: Frontend E2E validation of 3 features: (1) STATUT D'IMPORT — quote imported with 'Accepté' → backend status='signed' ✅; invoice imported with 'Payé' → backend status='paid' ✅; recap displays the status label correctly. (2) FILTRES CIBLE PUB — admin drill (users) shows filters block with plan filter (options 'free','premium' extracted from data), inactive checkbox; changing plan to 'free' reduces count 153→148; ticking 'Inactifs (+30j)' reduces count 153→137; admin drill (projects) shows the city filter. (3) E-MAIL GROUPÉ — search 'pro@construpilot.fr' returns 1 row, ticking it sets button label to 'E-mail (1)', opening the compose dialog. Empty send shows toast 'Objet et message requis' and dialog stays open. Filled send returns 200 {ok:true, sent:1, failed:0, total:1}, toast succès affiché, dialog fermé. All test artifacts (2 documents + 2 clients) supprimés via API.
